summary: Implemented load_decathlon_datalist in monai/data/utils.py (exported via monai.data). It reads an MSD-style JSON datalist, selects a key (default "training"), resolves relative paths against base_dir (defaults to the JSON file's directory), and returns a list of dicts with "image" and, when is_segmentation=True, "label". Test-set string items become {"image": path} when is_segmentation=False. Malformed input or a missing key raises ValueError. Added tests/test_load_decathlon_datalist.py covering these cases. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions. Examples and notebooks were not updated, and no changelog entry was added.
